summary: Frontend-only regression executed with new durable spec for reset/io/responsive flows. P2 and P3 passed; P1 exposed two critical product bugs in real reset flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Confirmation variant with trailing newline ("СБРОСИТЬ\n") triggers reset, although it must be rejected as non-exact variant.
After reset from lock screen and reload, user-uploaded file disappears (library returns to demo-only set). Requirement says uploaded file must remain.

integration_issues.issue: Lock config/state and file-key map are cleared as expected, but reset side-effects also remove user-uploaded file unexpectedly.

issues: Checked login/register at 1920x800 and 390x844, short-height simulation at 1920x360, and CSS zoom 125/150/200; no horizontal overflow found on active login form.
Short-height 360px is a simulation; real mobile keyboard insets were not emulated by browser virtual keyboard APIs in this run.

action_items: Fix reset confirmation comparator/input handling so "СБРОСИТЬ\n" and other non-exact variants cannot trigger reset.
Fix reset flow so user-uploaded files persist across reset+reload while only lock config/file-key wrappers are wiped.
After fixes, rerun /app/tests/e2e/45-access-reset-io-responsive.spec.ts and verify P1 fully green.
critical_code_review_comments: components/reset-lock-dialog.tsx relies on a plain input + equality check (`confirmation === 'СБРОСИТЬ'`) in submit path; newline normalization in input allows bypass of intended 'variant must fail' rule.

lib/store/lock.tsx::resetLock calls wipeLockData() only, but observed runtime behavior drops uploaded file data after reset/reload; investigate lock-reset side effects in storage rehydration/seed initialization path.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable local test data in browser context: one uploaded file, one vault secret entry, one encrypted export file. No backend seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/e2e/45-access-reset-io-responsive.spec.ts. Current status: P2 (secret IO + backup open validation) and P3 (responsive/zoom matrix smoke) pass; P1 fails on newline variant reset and uploaded-file persistence after reset. Evidence in /app/test_reports/access-iteration45.log and screenshots_iter45.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Reset confirmation uses direct string equality on normalized single-line input, so pasted/newline variant can collapse to exact token and pass. Repro: open lock reset dialog -> fill 'СБРОСИТЬ\n' -> Enter -> reset triggers. RCA-2: In actual reset flow from lock screen, post-reset reload returns library to demo-only dataset and uploaded file id cannot be found, indicating unintended data wipe/reinit beyond lock/file-key cleanup. Repro from spec P1 with persisted uploaded file id and post-reload lookup by data-tile-key.
